title: Laravel Developer
descriptionHtml:
Copper Kettle Software writes ordering systems for independent cafes. The stack is Laravel, Livewire and MySQL, deployed on a pair of boring virtual machines.

You will take over the loyalty module and the nightly export to the accountants.

title: Warehouse Systems Developer
descriptionHtml:
Tall Oak Supply ships garden tools from three warehouses. The scanners talk to a Node.js service that you will keep running and slowly replace.

Hourly contract, on site in Columbus, because the scanners are there.
